summary: Bug fix verification complete: All 4 bugs fixed correctly. 1) Loan/Investment navigation from all pages goes to /wealth/:type/:id detail page. 2) Past EMIs without ledger data show status='paid' not 'missed' - HDFC Loan shows 72 Paid, 0 Missed, 75 Pending. 3) Extra payment modal has 3 modes (Reduce Tenure, Reduce EMI, Prepay Principal). 4) reduce_principal mode keeps emiAmount and tenureMonths unchanged.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fixes verified: 1) Navigation from MyLiabilities, CategoryLoan, CategoryInvestment, MyExpenses, CategoryExpenses all use /wealth/loans/:id and /wealth/investments/:id routes. 2) EMI status fix verified - HDFC Loan shows 72 Paid, 0 Missed, 75 Pending (no missed EMIs). 3) Extra payment modal has 3 modes working correctly. 4) reduce_principal mode only updates outstandingAmount, keeps EMI and tenure unchanged.

past_emis_paid_not_missed.details: Backend code (loans.py line 392-394) sets past EMIs without ledger to 'paid'. API test confirms missedEMIs=0 for HDFC Loan. Frontend shows 72 Paid, 0 Missed, 75 Pending.

extra_payment_3_modes.details: LoanDetail.js has 3 mode buttons: mode-reduce-tenure, mode-reduce-emi, mode-reduce-principal. Screenshot confirms all 3 visible in modal.

reduce_principal_mode_behavior.details: POST /api/loans/:id/extra-payment with mode=reduce_principal reduces outstanding but keeps emiAmount and tenureMonths unchanged. Verified by API test.
